summary: Vehicle pursuit that ran from 30th Street to Union Avenue toward Highway 178. Officers set a perimeter and used a drone; the driver was described as a Hispanic male, about 56 years old and 175 pounds.
Neighbor dispute on Kernita Road following a backyard fire; officers asked to back the reporting party.
Semi truck roughly 50 percent involved with a detached trailer and about an eighth of an acre of grass burning; Engine 26 on scene with CHP, and Caltrans posted closure signs for a ramp in the area.
Robbery at gunpoint on Denise Avenue; suspect described as a transient white male in his late 30s in a baseball cap and black face mask, pulling a wagon, accompanied by a white female.
Attempt to locate the victim of a domestic incident near 17th and Union; victim described as a Hispanic woman in her 30s in a blue dress, with the suspect in a red pickup truck in an alley.

Quarter-acre brush fire with a fast rate of spread and potential to run west; multiple engines, a water tender and additional wildland equipment responded, with crews split into Division Bravo and Division Yankee for a lengthy mop-up.
Verbal disturbance with additional subjects in the Weedpatch area; medical aid also requested.
Man whispering that he needed police on South Haley Street, then the call disconnected.
Alarm company reported two subjects near a business on Ming Avenue, one holding a gas can.

Semi truck with a trailer fully engulfed in the number three lane of northbound I-5 south of Grapevine. CHP and Engine 56 on scene with command established as the Tejon Incident; crews were still working the fire after 6 a.m. with traffic backing up to the Lebec service route and a heavy-duty tow called in.
Domestic incident at the Winco on Panama Lane: a man chased a woman through the parking lot before both left in a vehicle; officers broadcast a description.
Three subjects seen jumping a fence on King Street.
Dodge Ram with a car hauler on the right-hand shoulder with a possible engine fire; information secondhand from the driver's brother, with no contact from the driver and CHP asked to respond.
Welfare check in the Pacific and Mount Vernon area after a rambling 911 caller.

Possible burglary on Woodford Boulevard: two subjects on the property behind a white pickup, possibly taking items. Subjects were known to be in possession of firearms, though none were seen initially; officers later made contact and located a firearm.
Suspicious subjects on a train near Truxtun and Sonora, including one in all black; Metro officers and a security guard checked and found no burglary to the train car.
White BMW struck the center divide on I-5 and continued northbound toward Lebec; units later got behind a matching vehicle blocking the number one lane.

area: trucking yard south of Gibson Street
summary: Three subjects at a trucking yard south of Gibson Street with possible theft of items; deputies set a perimeter and the subjects ran, one headed south toward a fence with an officer holding the hole. One subject described as known to carry a knife.
